# Cyrillic → Latin bilingual fixtures

Synthetic held-out pairs: Russian source with intentional Cyrillic terms left
untranslated in English (and Latin leftovers in Russian). Hand-written — not
verbatim CX dump quotes. Inspired by leftover patterns seen in CX `ru2en`
research (`docs/p1-cx-corpora-notes-2026-10-30.md`).

| File | Direction signal |
|---|---|
| `settings.md` / `onboarding.md` | mixed Cyrillic in EN; Latin in RU |
| `payments.md` | `баланс`/`перевод` in EN; `pending` in RU |
| `dashboard.md` | `уведомлений`/`настройки` in EN |

Do not commit Wikimedia CX dumps here — only these short fixtures.
